---
title: "9. Foundation Models for Structured and Relational Data"
---

::: {.module-meta}
**Duration:** 12 weeks  
**Outcome:** Work with GNNs, relational data and tabular/relational foundation models.
:::

## Core topics

Graphs; message passing; GCN; GraphSAGE; GAT; heterogeneous graphs; relational databases as graphs; relational deep learning; tabular foundation models.

## Essential resources

- Stanford **CS224W: Machine Learning with Graphs** — <https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs224w/>
- Hamilton, W. L. (2020). *Graph Representation Learning*. <https://www.cs.mcgill.ca/~wlh/grl_book/>
- RelBench — <https://relbench.stanford.edu/>
- Hollmann, N., et al. (2025). Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model. *Nature*.

## Milestone

Compare hand-engineered boosted trees, a GNN and a tabular/relational foundation-model approach on a relational prediction problem.
